courses.title: Advanced Vibration Analysis Training
courses.summary: Five-day hands-on vibration analysis training on real rotor kits. Learn the concepts, see the faults, and practise diagnosis and balancing on the equipment.
topics: Balancing of rigid and flexible rotors
Oil whirl, rubs, gearbox and bearing faults
Natural frequency with an impact hammer
courses.prerequisites: Confirm prerequisites with the instructor before you register.

courses.title: Vibration Analysis: Online Course
courses.summary: A live two-day online course for working engineers covering fundamentals, plot interpretation, resonance and reporting.
courses.prerequisites: A working knowledge of rotating equipment is helpful. Confirm details when you enquire.
